prior_observer_status: Noel et al. and GEO/SRA availability were already surfaced in the 2026-10-16 Observer alert; this artifact adds a source-traceable design/control/replay audit and is not a second independent discovery or replication.

literature.title: A Gata4-Loxl2 axis controls ECM remodeling to enable scar-free spinal cord regeneration in zebrafish
literature.abstract_level_inference: In injured adult zebrafish spinal cord, loss of gata4 biases ERG glia toward ECM/fibroblast-like gene expression with higher loxl2b, collagen cross-linking and stiffness; pharmacological lysyl-oxidase inhibition was reported to improve bridging/functional recovery.
literature.constraints: The article reports causal perturbation and rescue, but original detailed figures, supplementary statistics and animal-level data have not been independently reproduced here.

GEO.design: Adult zebrafish with complete spinal transection; wildtype vs gata4wcm6/wcm6; injury verified immediately and at 1 dpi; snRNA-seq performed at 2 weeks post-injury.
GEO.reported_processing: Trailmaker demultiplex/barcoding/count matrices; Seurat v5; filter >500 detected genes per cell; PCA/UMAP/annotation

timepoint_audit.prohibited_interpretation: 2-wpi cross-sectional nuclei profiles cannot alone measure wound-state duration, lineage fate, cell clearance, collagen clearance or scar-resolution half-life.

verified_metadata_controls: WT complete spinal transection at 2 wpi
gata4 mutant complete spinal transection at 2 wpi
reported_paper_level_controls: uninjured comparison in abstract-level research context
pharmacological inhibition of Loxl2b activity with rescue
controls.reported_primary_abstract_support: Causal gene loss and pharmacological rescue are part of peer-reviewed abstract; exact animal-level balancing, vehicle-control setup, number of animals and inhibitor selectivity require full paper/supplement audit.
needed_for_expression_claim: true biological replicate identifiers for each matrix
pseudobulk by independent animal rather than treating nuclei as replicates
needed_for_ecm_causal_claim: off-target/specificity controls for BAPN or equivalent lysyl oxidase inhibitor
same-animal or controlled cohort stiffness, collagen, bridging and function

quantitative_publication_claims_to_repla.feature: glial and axonal bridge size at 2 wpi

quantitative_publication_claims_to_repla.claimed_effect: approximately 70% increase at 1 wpi and 108% increase at 2 wpi in mutants
bridging phenotype reportedly attenuates by 4 wpi while swimming impairment persists through 10 wpi

source_tier_for_quantitative_candidates.caveat: Numbers are provisional extraction targets, not validated study values, because full article figures/supplementary raw data were not independently inspected.

comparison_with_existing_JANUS.existing_design: Young rat transection with immediately placed stiffness-varied catechol-modified hydrogel and Piezo1/RhoA signal; mechanical stiffness manipulation confounded with hydrogel concentration/adhesion.
comparison_with_existing_JANUS.Noel_design: Adult zebrafish endogenous Gata4-Loxl2b axis, loss-of-function, collagen cross-link/stiffness and lysyl oxidase rescue.

data_access_attempt.result: GEO accession pages and NCBI BioProject metadata accessed and cross-checked; direct FTP binary attempt failed due to network/download access restriction.
